marcadores.explicacao_original: The crista ampullaris is a ridge-like structure that functions similarly to the macula in the utricle and in the saccule. However, in the crista the gelatinous layer forms a cupula that extends across the ampulla to the opposite wall. Changes in acceleration cause deflection of the cupula that stimulate receptor cells and initiate a neural response in CN VIII. Otoliths are absent in the crista.
